name: basekit
description: The shared foundation of the forebay AI-proxy ecosystem: config, logging and app detection, canonical IR, provider accounts, the routing engine, and the app-loader engine, as one package with a subpath per module.
author: intisy

scripts.emit: node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/emit-dts.mjs --java-dir . --module :contracts --module-dir contracts --out src/generated && node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/emit-dts.mjs --java-dir . --module :ir --module-dir ir --out src/ir/generated && node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/emit-dts.mjs --java-dir . --module :auth-contracts --module-dir auth-contracts --out src/auth/generated && node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/emit-dts.mjs --java-dir . --module :proxy-contracts --module-dir proxy-contracts --out src/proxy/generated
scripts.emit:teavm: node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/emit-dts.mjs --java-dir . --module :core-teavm --out src/generated && node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/emit-dts.mjs --java-dir . --module :ir-teavm --out src/ir/generated && node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/emit-dts.mjs --java-dir . --module :auth-teavm --out src/auth/generated && node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/emit-dts.mjs --java-dir . --module :proxy-teavm --out src/proxy/generated
scripts.build:teavm: node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/teavm-build.mjs --java-dir . --module :core-teavm --out src/generated/core.teavm.js && node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/teavm-build.mjs --java-dir . --module :ir-teavm --out src/ir/generated/core-ir.teavm.js && node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/teavm-build.mjs --java-dir . --module :auth-teavm --out src/auth/generated/core-auth.teavm.js && node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/teavm-build.mjs --java-dir . --module :proxy-teavm --out src/proxy/generated/core-proxy.teavm.js
scripts.build: npm run emit && npm run emit:teavm && npm run build:teavm && npm run build:classlib && tsc && npm run copy:generated && node build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck:tests && vitest run
scripts.copy:generated: node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/copy-generated.mjs --src src/generated --out dist/generated && node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/copy-generated.mjs --src src/ir/generated --out dist/ir/generated && node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/copy-generated.mjs --src src/auth/generated --out dist/auth/generated && node node_modules/@intisy/bayonet/scripts/copy-generated.mjs --src src/proxy/generated --out dist/proxy/generated
